_meta.description: Machine-readable mapping of every window.dataLayer event this codebase actually emits, for building the GTM container exactly per docs/gtm-configuration-blueprint.md. Do not hand-copy a generic GA4 ecommerce example over this -- this file reflects the real implemented schema, verified against the source files listed per event.
_meta.note: Both IDs above are configuration identifiers, not secrets.

item_schema.item_id: string, WooCommerce product or variation ID
item_schema.discount: number, optional, only present when real
item_schema.item_list_name: string, optional, only present with list context
item_schema.index: integer, optional, 1-based, only on view_item_list/select_item items

events.name: view_item_list
events.trigger: Shop archive page load, or single-product Related Products render

events.name: select_item
events.trigger: Click on a product-card link inside a tracked list

events.name: view_item
events.trigger: Single product page load

events.name: add_to_cart
events.trigger: Successful Store API cart add (product page, cross-sell, bundle page)

events.name: remove_from_cart
events.trigger: Quantity reduced to 0 or explicit Remove click

events.name: view_cart
events.trigger: Side-cart drawer opens

events.name: begin_checkout
events.trigger: "Secure Checkout" clicked in the side-cart drawer

events.name: add_shipping_info
events.trigger: A shipping rate becomes selected on the Blocks checkout page (Store API response observation)

events.name: add_payment_info
events.trigger: A payment-method radio is selected or pre-selected on the Blocks checkout page
events.notes: payment_type is the gateway's internal ID (e.g. 'stripe'), never card data

events.name: purchase
events.trigger: woocommerce_thankyou, deduplicated to once per order

events.name: refund
events.trigger: woocommerce_order_refunded

events.name: amazon_outbound_click
events.trigger: Amazon affiliate button click

events.name: adventure_kit_signup
events.trigger: Adventure Kit thank-you page load, only reachable via the whitelisted Mailchimp redirect key; sessionStorage-guarded against refresh/back-nav duplication

events.name: lead_signup_success
events.trigger: POST/redirect success feedback, forms with no dedicated thank-you page
events.notes: Never fires alongside adventure_kit_signup for the same submission (mutually exclusive by success_redirect_key presence)

events.name: signup_error
events.trigger: POST/redirect error feedback, any acquisition form
events.notes: error_reason is one of the fixed strings invalid|missing_name|unavailable|error -- never raw exception text or user input

events.name: format_selected
events.trigger: Variation chosen on a variable product

events.name: bundle_format_selected
events.trigger: Format toggle on Complete Collection page

events.name: bundle_page_view
events.trigger: Complete Collection page load

events.name: side_cart_opened
events.trigger: Side-cart drawer opens, any trigger

events.name: side_cart_cross_sell_clicked
events.trigger: "Add This Adventure" clicked

events.name: second_book_added
events.trigger: Cart reaches 2 distinct titles of a format

events.name: complete_set_reached
events.trigger: Cart reaches all titles of a format

events.name: bundle_add_to_cart
events.trigger: Bundle-form submission adds items

events.name: bundle_savings_applied
events.trigger: Complete set reached via bundle-form submission

events.name: teacher_popup_view / teacher_popup_close / teacher_popup_submit / teacher_popup_success
events.trigger: Teacher popup lifecycle (/teachers/ only)

events.name: parent_popup_view / parent_popup_close / parent_popup_submit / parent_popup_success
events.trigger: Parent popup lifecycle (sitewide except /teachers/)

events.name: bhp_debug_internal_order_purchase_suppressed
events.trigger: Internal/test order reaches thank-you page
events.notes: Staging only -- never fires on production, and no GTM trigger should be created for it

events.name: contextual_cta_click
events.trigger: Click on any CTA rendered by BHP_CTA_Engine::render()
events.notes: Phase 1D. Reuses nav.js's existing generic data-bhp-event click handler.

events.name: contextual_cta_view
events.trigger: CTA scrolled into view (50% threshold, fires once)
events.notes: Phase 1D. Reuses nav.js's existing generic data-bhp-impression-event IntersectionObserver.

events.name: related_content_click
events.trigger: Click on a Related Field Notes article card

events.name: landing_page_view
events.trigger: Campaign landing page scrolled into view

events.name: landing_page_cta_click
events.trigger: Click on a campaign-landing product/CTA block

events.name: lead_form_view
events.trigger: Any acquisition form scrolled into view

events.name: lead_form_start
events.trigger: First focus into an acquisition form's email field (fires once per element)
events.notes: Phase 1D. New data-bhp-focus-event mechanism in nav.js (delegated focusin + {once:true}). Focus only -- never reads field content.
